hints.text: Try writing $32$ as a power of $2$ so both sides share a base.
Same base means the exponents match: $x = 5$.

explanation: The same-base trick: make both sides powers of the SAME base.
If the bases match, the exponents must match: $x = 5$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Take a log of both sides
steps: A log and a power with the same base undo each other, so the left side is just $x$.
